text:
maria: Heads up — eu-west keystore audit retention change (50d -> 180d) rolled last night. We're seeing keystore-proxy timeouts + conntrack slab exhaustion on privatelink endpoints, which is blocking GPU warm-pool nodes from completing onboarding.

ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-proxy-euw / 503 x120 in 10m; conntrack_slab_full on privatelink-euw. Triggered: gpu-warmup-failures (count=27).

alex: Oof. Any quick logs/snippets? Is it the keystore itself or the NAT/conntrack layer?

maria: Quick grep from the node that failed to join: 
```
2026-03-22T03:12:04Z keystore-proxy euw3 503 "upstream timeout"
2026-03-22T03:12:05Z kubelet euw3 pod/warmup-xyz ErrImagePull -> keystore timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
```

jess: Sounds like conntrack exhaustion at the NAT/proxy layer. Short-term options: bump conntrack_max on edge NAT, or temporarily reduce keystore retention so audit shipper QPS drops. Both have tradeoffs.

kevin: Cost note: keeping retention at 180d increases S3 store + egress for audit exports in eu-west by ~+$8k/mo for current volume. If we rollback to 60d for the keystore index only, ops impact minimal and cost ~+$2k/mo.

alex: My suggested mitigation plan: 1) Can we apply a targeted rollback for the keystore-audit policy (keystore service only) to 60d as a canary? 2) In parallel, increase nf_conntrack_max on NATs in euw3 by 2x for 6h. 3) Monitor warm-pool joins for 30m; if stable, then decide retention window or infra fix.

jess: Commands I can run on the NAT fleet for a short burst: 
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
# check current count
sudo cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count
```

maria: I'm +1 for the canary rollback. I'll open the compliance exception ticket and ping Security for a scoped approval. We should document the rollback and re-run audits after.

kevin: Please capture the cost delta in the ticket. If Security insists on 180d, we need to schedule a proper infra fix (reduce keystore QPS via batching + exporter rate-limit) — not a permanent rollback.

alex: jess, can you run the NAT bump and I'll coordinate the policy tweak with infra-admin? If we see >95% success on node joins in 30m, we escalate to a permanent mitigation plan.

jess: On it, starting now. Will post results. :thumbsup:

maria: Also flagging region constraint: if euw3 keeps being noisy we'll shift new allocations to eu-central temporarily. Not ideal but lowers blast radius.

ops-bot: [INFO] keystore-audit-policy-change submitted (#INC-7421) — awaiting approval.

alex: thanks team. keep messages short in this thread w/ updates. If we need an incident channel I'll spawn one.
